messages:
maya: Quick async check — we're finalizing the token-latency breakdown section for the analytics handbook. Need owners/ETA for:
- event schema change (token.context fields)
- ingest mapping for token attribution
- sample data (latency hist buckets) + who can run smoke query
Goal: docs PR + dashboards update by EOW. Who's on each?
aj: I'm on schema + will open PR today (small change to event.payload.token_type). CC @lee for deploy window. :thumbsup:
lee: Can deploy schema to staging Wed 09:00 PT, prod Thu 13:00 PT. Need a migration plan for old events and a quick verification run. Also confirm Kafka retention covers the sampling window.
sam: For latency histograms I recommend p50/p95/p99 per model+route. I'll draft the sample query. Who can run the heavier agg on staging? Might need a dedicated slot.
dina: From product: acceptance = dashboard with token-cost attribution by route, and <10% misattribution in our sample. Also want example regression alerts (spikes in p99 or unexpected cost weight shifts).
aj: PR incoming: https://git.company/repo/pull/4389 — includes schema change + unit tests. Pinging eng-reviews for a quick look. Sam, can you validate against your query once deployed?
sam: Will validate after staging deploy. Filing issue for KV cache reporting — it isn't wired into events yet (#292). That could affect attribution for cached hits.
maya: Ownership summary (please confirm):
- schema & PR: aj
- deploy & migration plan: lee
- latency sampling & validation: sam
- dashboard aggs & alerts: dina
- docs + handbook PR: maya
If anything needs to move, call it out here. Thanks! :sparkles:
deploy-bot: Staging schema deploy scheduled for 2024-03-20 09:00 PT — job 78421 queued.
aj: quick code-review ping to @eng-platform reviewers — 2 small comments left, should be quick.
lee: Verified Kafka retention covers 30d sample window, so we won't lose event history for the planned queries.
sam: Ran smoke query on staging after test deploy, sample query used:
```
SELECT model, route, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p99
FROM tokens.events_staging
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY model, route;
```
p99s look sane: most routes < 1200ms, /batch-embed is ~1800ms (expected). Attaching rough CSV to the PR.
maya: I'll start the docs PR draft and tag reviewers. Aiming to merge docs + alerts config by Friday.
aj: Addressing the review comments now, will update PR before EOD.
dina: I'll draft alert thresholds and share in this thread once done.
maya: thanks everyone — will update the handbook checklist and close the loop once dashboards validate.
